proposal.title: Kajenn Press: inventory of the code against the site tab redesign
proposal.author: Giovanni Porcari

problem.p: changes the administration and the publication model. Before any code changes, every part of the existing code, every REST/MCP operation, every test suite and every deployment file needs a stated fate, and the upstream capabilities the redesign relies on need to be checked.

Classification used throughout: keep (unchanged), change (kept and adapted), replace (removed, a named new part takes its role), remove (removed with no successor). Capabilities are exists, partial or missing.

section.title: Upstream capabilities
section.p: Repositories read on 2026-10-27: genro-storage dd62bfd, genro-bag 2293047, kajenn 6ac7e58, gramlot d01bf3d; genro-builders 0.30.0 as installed in the kajenn-press environment. The kajenn-press environment installs genro-storage 0.8.4, genro-bag 0.28.0 and kajenn 0.5.0 from PyPI; the checkouts read here can differ from those releases. Gramlot is not installed in the kajenn-press development environment; the Gramlot checks ran in the Gramlot checkout's own environment.

section.title: Genro Storage
section.fact: The S3 backend sets version_aware=True by default.
The versioning capability is derived from the s3fs client only; the bucket's versioning state is never queried.
get_versions(path) lists versions with id, latest flag, date, size and etag; any exception returns an empty list.
open_version(path, version_id) opens a version for reading; delete_version follows at line 886.
section.p: No restore, rollback or promote function exists in genro-storage: a search for them in src/ found nothing. Restoring today means reading a version and writing it as the current object; this was not tried against S3.
section.limit: S3-compatible servers without ListObjectVersions need version_aware=False. Whether the Hetzner bucket kpress-releases has versioning enabled was not checked.
section.fact: A zip mount addresses a ZIP archive as a filesystem, with file, mode and a target protocol.
node.zip() returns deflated ZIP bytes of a file, a directory or an iterator of nodes.

section.title: Genro Bag
section.fact: to_tytx(transport="json"|"msgpack") serializes a Bag, optionally to a file.
A Bag with a nested Bag holding bytes survives to_tytx/from_tytx in JSON: the value comes back as the same bytes. Through to_xml/from_xml the bytes come back as a string.
section.p: Pickle is also lossless, as reported by the research run; the msgpack transport needs the msgpack package, which the environment lacks. Neither was re-run here.
No zipped Bag format exists: a search for to_zip/from_zip in genro-bag found nothing. A zipped site source needs TYTX plus Python zipfile, or the genro-storage zip mount.
section.fact: BagResolver (line 89) takes cache_time: 0 no cache, positive a TTL in seconds, negative until reset().
BagCbResolver wraps a callback as a resolver with the same cache options.

section.title: Gramlot and HtmlBuilder
section.fact: div(node_label='info', kpress_slot='main') and td(kpress_slot=True) keep the attribute in the source Bag; getNode('html_0.body.center.info') reaches the node by its label path; findNodeByAttr('kpress_slot', 'main') returns it; server rendering emits <div kpress_slot="main"> and <td kpress_slot="true">.
Unknown attribute names pass to the output; names starting with gramlot_ are an error.
The kajenn-press static profile accepts the HTML tags of STATIC_TAGS only; other nodes fail with unsupported_static_node (line 204).
section.p: Layout widgets such as contentPane render as custom elements that need the Gramlot JS runtime, as reported by the research run. In static HTML a slot is therefore a plain element: div, section, td and similar.
section.fact: The editor collection defines codeMirror, htmlEditor (line 2599, Jodit) and htmlPreview (line 4754).
Detachable panes and floating palettes of legacy GenroPy are investigated (GC-185, 2026-09-25) and marked "not implemented".
The tree component is a drag source.
Drag and drop works within one renderer; other windows and instances are not admitted.
section.p: The HTML preview renders through srcdoc in a sandboxed iframe, so a content dragged from the drawer cannot be dropped on a slot of the rendered page as the preview works today.

section.title: Kajenn
section.fact: set_result handles paths, bytes, strings and JSON values; there is no support for storage nodes.
The server answers 503 while its lifespan is not running; there is no per-site maintenance state.
section.p: Kajenn has no response cache; kajenn-press keeps its own in-memory cache of the release manifest in child.py.

list.item: genro-storage: restore a version as current, through a server-side copy with VersionId; query the bucket's versioning state. Reproducer: node.restore_version(vid) raises AttributeError.
genro-bag: a zipped Bag file holding nested Bags and binary values. Reproducer: Bag.from_xml(b.to_xml(doc_header=True))['a.bin'] is a string, and no to_zip exists.
gramlot: a detachable floating pane holding a tab container (GC-185). Reproducer: no floatingPane in the layout collection.

gramlot: drop onto nodes of a rendered page shown inside the editor. Reproducer: a tree with draggable=True and a dropTarget div inside htmlPreview; the drop is not delivered. An alternative that needs no upstream change: render the preview in the same document instead of a sandboxed iframe; to be decided in Phase 5.
kajenn: per-site maintenance state and a response cache on the local filesystem, or both kept in kajenn-press; to be decided in Phase 4.

section.title: Catalog and services
section.p: Today one local catalog holds every record of an installation as immutable JSON revisions with generations, receipts, audit and content-addressed payloads. The redesign keeps a site's source as one zipped Bag on S3, versioned by S3 (), and pages hold autonomous copies carrying the original id ().
section.fact: LocalCatalog is a single-owner, thread-serialized store with an owner.lock; commit (line 347) writes changes under authorization and an idempotency key, recover (line 538) repairs an interrupted publication.
Snapshot carries generation, records, revisions, receipts, audit and events; Change (line 27) carries scope, record id, expected generation, data and payloads.
ObjectStore keeps immutable payloads addressed by ObjectRef (key, sha256, size) through Genro Storage on a local root.
EditorialService.execute checks identity, binds arguments, authorizes, and for mutations enforces a key of at most 256 characters, returning the prior receipt when the key and input repeat.
resource_copy records copied_from with the source revision; updates keep it (lines 583 and 628).
The publication service commits to the same catalog; jobs and releases read payloads from it (publication/jobs.py:114, publication/releases.py:102). Replacing the catalog affects Phase 4.
EDITORIAL_KINDS are site, content, variant, template, css, javascript, media.
AccessPolicy maps identity to scopes (installation, library, site:<id>, *) and permission names, supplied by the host.
